script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl60_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("54-1");
		    if dialog.show("Level60-1", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level60-2", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level60-3", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level60-4", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		    if dialog.show("Level60-5", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("52-1");
			if dialog.show("Level60-6", faceShijin) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl60_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
